name: DP DESIGN PTE LTD
description:
DP Design Pte Ltd (DPD) has been in operation since 1982 and has undertaken many significant projects in Singapore and overseas.  Prior to its formation, DPD was an in-house interior design arm of DP Architects (DPA). This working relationship enabled DPD to acquire the skill and ability to synthesize architectural and interior design in buildings as an integrated and wholesome solution.
The directors of DPD are all qualified architects and this attribute enabled them to fully understand and comprehend the architectural and spatial relationship and potential of projects undertaken. It is manifested in many projects handled by the firm.
The appointment of the firm in 1997 to undertake the interior design of The Esplanade ?Theatres on the Bay marks the beginning of the firm?s involvement in large civic and commercial projects. This project consists of a 2000 seats concert hall, 1800 seat lyric theatre and related commercial facilities. The successful completion of this project enabled the firm to secure works in other large projects such as the interior design of The HDB HUB, Ministry of Foreign Affairs Building, The Singapore Press Holdings HQ, The Singapore Stock Exchange and the refurbishment of Marina Square Mall. We have also been commissioned to undertake large overseas projects such as The Dubai Mall and the Performing Arts Centre in Suzhou China.
DPD has developed its expertise beyond interior design. It has been commissioned to undertake space planning for large corporate offices and the positioning and branding strategy for retail outlets. These have built upon the continual desire to explore new grounds and to extend the frontier of interior design as the sole objective to a broader and holistic concept of design that embraces all aspects of commercial and individual needs of our clients.

name: DP FACADE PTE. LTD.
description:

Our extensive knowledge and multidisciplinary approach in facade engineering consistently deliver exceptional solutions that are original, practical and within budget. Our emphasis on being actively involved early in the development process provides our clients with greater opportunities to customise facade designs and solutions to their specific needs. We use the most advanced computer modelling software to carry out the parametric engineering of key structural elements of the facade for fast optimisation and value-engineering. description:
Intelligent Energy Systems (IES) is an established consulting and software company that provides advisory services and software solutions to organisations dealing in energy markets. While IES specialises in reforming and reformed electricity markets, it also does work in gas markets and macro/national energy systems. Central to the IES business model is research and development, which feeds into its advisory work and software products.
Within Australia IES advisory work includes leadership in the establishment of the de-regulated energy markets, economic and market studies associated with future price outcomes and risk assessment, support to M&A activities, macro energy market studies, regulatory and policy advice, renewable energy products, training on a variety of issues, and strategic advice to trading companies.
Outside of Australia IES works in countries that include Ireland, New Zealand, Singapore and many of the ASEAN countries. Such work includes a review of the benefits the reformed electricity market has brought to Singapore, World Bank funded training programs, and the institutional strengthening and broad approaches to energy policy analysis in six of the ASEAN countries.
IES is the dominant supplier of electricity market modelling and market data visualisation software in Australia. IES software is also used and supplied in New Zealand, Singapore, UK and Ireland.
IES clients within and outside of Australia include electricity generation and energy retailing businesses trading in electricity and gas markets, industry and market regulators, banks and investors, government, transmission companies, and market and system operators.

description:
Openpedia AI Pte Ltd is a Singapore-registered technology company specializing in knowledge-grounded Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions, with a particular focus on secure, single-tenant deployments, including fully on-premises, air-gapped environments, for organizations with strict data residency and security requirements.
The company began with encyclopedic knowledge systems and has extended this knowledge layer to AI assistants that remain grounded in structured data and curated corpora. Capabilities span the full delivery stack: ontology and metadata design, entity normalization and linking, retrieval pipelines over structured and unstructured corpora, citation-ready synthesis with provenance, and tool-using agentic workflows with human review and traceability built in. Solutions are packaged as containerized services and APIs for repeatable deployments on-premises, in dedicated Singapore co-located infrastructure, or in isolated single-tenant cloud environments (AWS/GCP). For restricted environments, internet sourcing can be disabled entirely and replaced with allow listed or offline corpora and customer-provided knowledge bases.

We provide psychological services for children with special needs; in particular Autism Spectrum Disorder. We conduct assessments, intervention, school observations, consultations and training. Our Educational Psychologist, Mr Bimal Rai, has over 20 years experience working with children with special needs. Apart from providing intervention, such as TEACCH, PECS, Social Stories, etc., he is an RDI Program Certified Consultant. Where a child lacks certain developmental milestones, RDI plugs these gaps gradually and systematically. Using the principles of RDI we aim to empower parents and teachers in managing children with special needs or learning difficulties. By imparting practical knowledge and strategies parents and teachers walk away with a better understanding of the condition afflicting the child and how they can help ease the struggles faced by our youngsters through intervention.
Children we have worked with have demonstrated the following:
Improved Perspective Taking
Developments in Flexible Thinking in relation to the social world
Increased Desire to Interact with others
Dramatic improvement in Meaningful Communication
An Increased Sense of Competency
Schools or agencies who seek training or workshops can tell us of their needs and we will customize a programme to suit their requirements. Training/Workshops we have conducted include:
Managing Controlling Behaviour
Autism: The Core Deficits
Understanding the ADHD Profile and Difficulties in School
Individualized Education Plans
RDI: Bridging the Social Gaps
Shadow Teacher training
Workshops for Social Stories,TEACCH, PECS, etc.

description:
An organization's needs to get a quick and accurate view of their business in this VUCA (Volatile, Uncertain, Complex and Ambiguous) world.
Radical innovations have arisen in Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) technologies with SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP BPC and SAP S/4 HANA leading the way. However, even with all the innovations, operationalizing an efficient EPM process is a challenge due to the traditional approach taken for adopting these solutions. These approaches heavily focus on ineffective application configuration instead of a business-relevant, collaborative process design.
On a mission to provide organizations with a risk-free SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) for Planning, SAP BPC and S/4 HANA for Group Reporting adoptions, Red Apricot developed JustPerform. It took more than 18 months to build this unified platform using all our combined experience and in-depth knowledge of implementation processes.
Today, using the power of our purpose-built cloud platform JustPerform, Red Apricot leads organizations away from an ineffective application configuration towards collaborative process design and automated deployments.
JustPerform simplifies collaborative business process definition, enables visual process modelling and automates process deployment using advanced Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning algorithms. To put it in simple terms, using the JustPerform platform, project stakeholders can input the desired elements of their EPM strategy, and our AI-based algorithms automatically write the code for fast and successful deployment.
With the purpose-built JustPerform, Red Apricot has been rapidly growing in the SAP EPM space. It has been recognized as one of the top 10 innovative EPM solution providers by APAC CIO Outlook in their Enterprise Performance Management Special Edition. Additionally, Red Apricot is an SAP Gold Partner and has SAP Recognized Expertise status in Enterprise Planning and Analysis.

name: SatSense Ltd
description:
SatSense is a UK geospatial analytics company specialising in Interferometric Synthetic Aperture Radar (InSAR) for ground and asset movement monitoring. Headquartered in Leeds, we deliver readily available and affordable displacement insights that help infrastructure owners, operators, and their consultants improve the resilience and safety of transport, utilities, energy and the built environment.
Our platform turns satellite radar into clear, decision-ready intelligence; tracking millimetre-scale movement over large areas and long time spans. We provide baseline studies, time-series analysis, trend/change detection and alerting, with outputs delivered via dashboards, GIS files and reports to fit existing workflows.
What we do
Nationwide to site-specific monitoring for rail, highways, water, energy, ports and property.
Construction and asset risk management: subsidence, uplift, settlement, tunnelling impacts and third-party works.
Event and anomaly assessment (e.g., strike/impact investigations) and post-event forensics.
Portfolio screening to prioritise inspections and optimise maintenance budgets.
How we do it
Advanced processing of open and commercial SAR data (e.g., Sentinel-1 and historical archives such as ERS/Envisat/ALOS, plus taskable missions where required).
Scalable pipelines that rapidly produce consistent, comparable results at city, corridor or national scale.
Easy integration with client GIS and asset systems; clear communication of uncertainty and confidence.
SatSense combines radar science with practical engineering know-how to reduce risk, target investigations and cut cost. Our mission is to be the leading provider of readily available and affordable InSAR ground movement data and derived products, supporting smarter, safer and more sustainable infrastructure.

description:
SHEVS IFT CONSULTANTS PTE LTD is a licensed corporation registered with the Professional Engineers Board to offer professional engineering consultancy services. SHEVS specialises in fire/smoke control and fire safety engineering designs based on the Singapore Fire Codes and the Singapore Fire Safety Engineering Guidelines 2015.
Very often, the increasing scale or complexity of building architectural designs will inevitably result to challenging circumstances for the implementation of prescriptive code-compliant fire safety measures. Some of the common deviations to prescriptive fire code are :
i. Engineered smoke control system
- Enlarged smoke reservoir size and length
- Inadequate atrium space in width and area
- Enlarged fire compartment
ii. Means of escape
- Extended travel distances
- Excessive egress capacity of occupants
- Internal discharge of exit staircases
iii. Set back distances from notional boundary
- Insufficient set back distance
iv. Carpark ductless jet fan systems
For cost-effectiveness and flexibility, these non-compliances are usually submitted to SCDF as waiver applications with the relevant supporting reasons at the earliest stage. Performance-based approaches should only be adopted when the waiver applications are rejected because the process for performance-based submission can be very tedious and extensive.
SHEVS Innovative Fire Technology experience, judgment and expertise coupled with locally in-house support for the validated simulation tools and software, the approval process for performance-based submissions can be expedited significantly.

name: SPD
description:
SPD serves people with physical, sensory and learning disabilities, helping them to maximise their potential and become self-reliant and independent. Founded in 1964 by a group of Rotarians, it was known as Society for Aid to the Paralysed (SAP). In the earlier years, SAP provided employment opportunities at its sheltered workshop to people with disabilities who had difficulties seeking open employment. The organisation was renamed Society for the Physically Disabled (SPD) in May 1998 and subsequently to just SPD in July 2014 to better reflect the work that we do - serving people beyond physical disabilities.
With milestones that spans over 50 years, SPD Sheltered Workshop now offers professional outsourcing solutions to companies/organisations that require packing, packaging and bookbinding/book restoration services. The deliverables are fulfilled by a group of people with special needs whose abilities are clearly reflected in the works that they produce which are of commercial quality and standards.
While working on these commercial projects, people with special needs in the workshop gain real-time job experience and pick up interpersonal and soft skills which help to increase their employability. Through the SPD Sheltered Workshop, we hope to train and graduate our trainees into open employment so that they can be integrated into the society and become self-reliant.
Every project that we secure or products that were purchased represent valuable training and employment opportunities, taking us a step closer towards our goals of helping our trainees to become financially independent. We are pleased to present to you the following professional outsourcing services that our workshop offers:
1. Line Assembling and Packaging
2. Document Scanning and Archiving
3. Book Binding and Book Restoration
4. Production of Lifestyle Gifts and Corporate Gifts

STA INSPECTION PTE LTD
description:
STA Inspection Pte Ltd (STAI) was established in 1982 to provide vehicle inspection services in Singapore with approval from the Land Transport Authority (LTA). Since its inception, STAI has gone from an inspection company that is only restricted to the inspection of Heavy Goods Vehicles and motorcycles to one that is able to inspect all types of in-used vehicles in Singapore. STAI was also involved in the inspection of military vehilces since MINDEF started its requirement to have all its fleet of vehicles go through compulsory roadworthiness inspection and has since performed its duty with excellence till to-date. Today, we also handle the Vehicle Inspection and Type Approval System (VITAS) services for LTA in the areas of inspection and documentation e.g Type Approval, Change of Vehicle Particulars, etc.
With our quest to excel, we also provide consultancy vehicle inspection services in the set-up of inspection centres and training of inspectors as far back as in 1990s.
Currently we have 2 centres in Singapore using the state-of-the-art fully integrated test lane equipment with full connection between the two centres.
1n 1996, STAI was awarded the Approved Training Centre status by the Institute of Technical Education (ITE) for the conduct of the Motor Vehicle Inspection Course (MVIC) - an endorsement of the standards with which STAI conducts its overseas and local training. The inspectors in STAI are therefore fully trained on the MVIC with a minimum qualification of National Trade Certicate Level 3 (now, called NITEC)as required by LTA.
STAI becomes the first inspection company in Singapore to acheive the ISO 9002 certification in 1994. With its relentless pursuit for excellence, it achieved yet another first in the ISO 9001:2000 in 2000 and also becomes the first inspection company in Singapore to achieve the prestigious Singapore Quality Class accolade.

name: URBAN STRATEGIES INC.
description:
Urban Strategies Inc. is a full-service planning and urban design firm, based in Toronto, Canada.  Working for public and private sector clients, we shape and enhance urban places of all scales through strategic actions, holistic design and progressive policies.  Since 1981, our work has earned the firm dozens of awards and an international reputation.  Our hallmark:  consensus-driven solutions that are both visionary and achievable.
Philosophy:
Because every client, community and place are different, Urban Strategies� approaches each assignment with no preconceived formulas or solutions, but we do bring a philosophy of urbanism that includes the following tenets:
� The careful management of urban growth and controlled evolution of cities is essential to the quality of human lives and the health of the planet.
� City building is a great collective project that relies on many disciplines, citizen participation and an appreciation for history.
� Successful cities marry public and private interests, aligning them in the planning and design of communities.
� Streets are both the arteries and connective tissue of cities, the places for moving people and goods via transit, cars, trucks, bikes and feet, but also the places for enjoying the diverse cultures, tastes and merchandise a city offers.
� Development and open spaces should be located, shaped and designed in a way that enhances the character of neighbourhoods and the vitality of the public realm.
� Cities must be rooted in nature, and natural features and systems must be rooted in cities:  trees and green spaces should be plentiful, and water, whatever its shape or source, should be accessible and integrated into the design of places.
� Campuses are places and communities unto themselves, where efficiency, sustainable growth, a distinct identity and healthy connections to surroundings are critical to success.
